segments.text:
Fourthly, In receiving Christ, beware of dangerous delays.
O follow on that work till it be finished: you read of some that are almost perswaded, and others not far from the kingdome of God. O take heed of sticking in the birth, Hosea 13. 13. delays here are full of danger, life is uncertain, so are means of grace too: the man-slayer needed no motives to quicken his flight to the refuge City.
